info.name: UniWare — Sprint 1 Backend (Debugging Collection)
info.description:
Covers every Sprint 1 endpoint (US1-1..US1-3, US2-1..US2-3, US2-5, US3-1, US3-4) with both the AC-P (happy path) and AC-N (failure) case for each. See docs/POSTMAN_DEBUGGING_GUIDE.md (or the published guide) for how the CSRF/session auto-injection scripts below work and how to read each failure.

Run folders top-to-bottom in order the first time — each folder logs in as whichever persona it needs, so later folders don't silently depend on state left over from earlier ones, EXCEPT folders 6-10 which reuse {{equipment_id}}/{{category_id}}/{{location_id}} captured by folders 5 and 6.

item.description: The 'No session' request has Settings > 'Send cookies automatically' disabled (protocolProfileBehavior.disableCookies) so it is a true anonymous request regardless of what is in the shared cookie jar.
